decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk fits the growing workplace segment, its prospects are still uncertain after one year, and keeping it costs little, so the option stays open.
A chair family is a core, broadly applicable line with its own page, and it is too early for the results to justify abandoning it.
Floor cushions made from carpets are a niche accessory with more uncertain value, but they use rug materials the firm already has, so the cost of keeping them is low and the option is kept for now.
The sofa is only mentioned rather than featured, which hints at weaker prospects, but upholstered seating is central to premium living ranges and further evidence is worth waiting for.
The high standing table complements the flexible office and conference offering at little added cost, so it is kept while demand becomes clear.
As the flagship rug collection that signals the firm's strategic direction, it warrants further commitment rather than abandonment.
